seoTitle: Time Tracker Log: Hours per Project and Day with CSV Export
metaDescription: Paste time entries with start-end times or durations and get totals per project and day, a project-by-day grid and a CSV. Free.
intro: Adds up a log of time entries by project and by day, in a text summary and a downloadable CSV.
why:
Write entries like 2026-10-19 Website 09:00-11:30 homepage, or use a duration such as 2.5h or 1h30m. The tool totals hours per project, per day and in a project-by-day grid, with percent share per project.

There is no running timer in this tool; time the work with the stopwatch and write the result in. Entries that cross midnight are counted on the start date. Nothing is stored; the CSV is created in your browser, so you can keep the log in your own file.
howTo: Write one entry per line: date project time note.
Read the totals and the grid.

faq.q: Does it have a start/stop timer?
faq.a: No. Use the stopwatch and enter the time here.
